description: Defines the CandidateVacancy entity class for ORM, representing a candidate's application to a vacancy in the HRM system.

classes.name: CandidateVacancy
classes.description: Entity class representing a candidate's application to a vacancy, with ORM mappings and accessor methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the candidate vacancy record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the candidate vacancy record.

methods.name: getCandidate
methods.description: Returns the Candidate associated with this vacancy application.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Associates a Candidate with this vacancy application.

methods.name: getVacancy
methods.description: Returns the Vacancy associated with this application.

methods.name: setVacancy
methods.description: Associates a Vacancy with this candidate application.

methods.name: getAppliedDate
methods.description: Returns the date the candidate applied.
